title: Median earnings and earnings distribution
detail: Only mean weekly earnings (ONS AWE from 2000; Bank of England composite series 1990-1999) are integrated. ONS ASHE median pay is not yet imported, so 'income level' is expressed as a multiple of average earnings, not a true percentile.

title: Earnings series break at 2000
detail: 1990-1999 uses the Bank of England composite average weekly earnings; 2000 onward uses ONS AWE (whole economy, total pay). The two overlap 2000-2016 and differ by a few percent. The dashboard flags years that use the earlier series.

title: Household disposable income
detail: ONS household disposable income per head is not yet integrated; take-home pay is computed for a single employee from HMRC tax rules, excluding benefits, tax credits, pension contributions and student loans.

title: Average private rent in £
detail: No £ rent levels are integrated. ONS rental indices start in 2005 and do not give £ levels back to 1990. Renting vs buying cannot yet be compared.

title: Council Tax
detail: Average Band D Council Tax (MHCLG) is not yet imported. ONS local-government Council Tax receipts are shown as an aggregate only.

title: Mortgage rates 1990-1994
detail: 1990-1994 uses the building societies' basic mortgage rate (ONS AJNK via the Bank of England historical dataset); 1995 onward uses the Bank of England quoted household rate. The two agree within 0.03pp in the 1995 overlap.

title: Deposit requirements and first-time-buyer data
detail: Typical deposit/loan-to-value by year is not integrated. The calculator uses a user-set deposit percentage (an assumption, not an observation).

title: RPI average-price series end in 2024 or earlier
detail: ONS RPI average prices stop at 2024 for most items, 2023 for pork, 2021 for eggs (size 4) and 2012 for butter. 2025-26 comparisons use the latest observation only if you switch that option on, and the page labels it.

title: Rice, pasta and several staples
detail: No continuous ONS average-price series for rice or pasta was found. They are listed as unavailable, not estimated.

title: Energy bills in £ before 2010
detail: DESNZ publishes £ bills from 2010 in the tables used here. For earlier years the dashboard can show only the ONS CPI electricity/gas/other-fuels index, clearly marked as an index-scaled estimate, not an observed bill.

title: Five vehicle categories (small, family, mid-range, van, luxury)
detail: No benchmark vehicle prices, insurance premiums in £, MOT, servicing, tyres or VED rates are integrated. Only the ONS quality-adjusted new-car and motor-insurance price indices, rail-fare index and petrol/diesel pump prices are available.

title: VAT, fuel duty, VED, Corporation Tax, Stamp Duty rate histories
detail: Income Tax and employee National Insurance rules are imported from HMRC for every tax year from 1990-91. Rate histories for the other taxes are not yet imported; only their receipts (ONS) are shown where available.

title: Complete receipts breakdown
detail: PAYE income tax receipts start in 1993 in the ONS series used; total income tax, corporation tax receipts and total public-sector receipts are not yet integrated. Components overlap and must not be summed.

title: Corporate financial results
detail: No company financial statements are integrated yet. Planned sources: SEC EDGAR XBRL for 20-F filers (BP, Shell, Barclays, HSBC, NatWest, Lloyds) and annual reports for Tesco, Sainsbury's, Morrisons and Centrica. Group results must not be read as UK results.

title: Regional earnings
detail: Regional house prices are integrated; regional earnings are not, so regional affordability ratios use national earnings.

title: Mortgage interest tax relief (MIRAS) before April 2000
detail: Relief at source on the first £30,000 of mortgage interest was available until April 2000 and is not modelled, so pre-2000 repayment-mortgage costs are overstated relative to what many borrowers actually paid.
